description: FinVerify A/B/C/D experiment configuration. Fixed before the formal run; the runner refuses to run LLM versions on test filings unless frozen_prompts matches the current prompt files.

ollama.notes: Free local model (no API key, no rate limits, data stays on the machine). Greedy decoding with a fixed seed. Thinking disabled for every version, so version A has no hidden reasoning: its only reasoning is the visible calculation_steps field. max_tokens is num_predict, identical for every step of every version.

anthropic.notes: Optional paid alternative, not used for the reported results. temperature/top_p/top_k are not accepted by this model; adaptive thinking cannot be disabled; no refusal fallback (it would switch models mid-experiment).

structured_outputs: every structured step of every version is constrained to its JSON schema (Ollama: format; Anthropic: output_config.format) and validated again in code
dev_note: Prompts are developed only on the toy filings and the dev filing. Headline results use the other 13 filings (52 records). AAPL_2026 is the same company as the dev filing, so a robustness row excluding all AAPL filings (12 filings, 48 records) is also reported.

proposed_metric_rules.status: proposal, to be agreed with the analysis owner before the formal run
proposed_metric_rules.denominator: for every version, all ground-truth-available (filing x ratio) records of the split; identical across versions
proposed_metric_rules.correct: status == ok (or low_confidence_negative_equity with a value) and the value is within the tolerance
proposed_metric_rules.abstention: missing_input, unit_mismatch (including version A result = null) count as incorrect and are reported separately as the abstention rate
proposed_metric_rules.failures: parse_failure, truncated, refusal, api_error, no_tool_call count as incorrect and are reported separately
proposed_metric_rules.tolerance: proposed: relative error <= 1%, fixed before the formal run
